F21.role: procedure diagnostic (Study 7 M analogue; essential stress test)

testRules.T1: centre minute DD over the continuous run to the test end < $35,000
testRules.T2: test sets 1–3 (fresh seeds, 128 each) pooled share < $35k ≥ 0.90 and pooled p90 < $35,000 on the run to the test end; T2b: in-box pair likewise when a coordinate is within r of a bound
testRules.T3: test-window centre net ≥ $10000 per test year, and pooled test-set median test-window net > 0 and ≥ $5000 per test year
testRules.T4: under 10 bps, 14% interest, next-open stops and +25 bps slippage: test-window centre net > 0 and run DD < $35,000
testRules.T5: on the run to the test end: best calendar year (2026 counted as a year) ≤ 75% of net; ex-best-year economy ≥ $5000/yr; largest lot ≤ 25% of net
testRules.T6: activity: on the run to the test end the Q5 floors with y = the run's years (lots ≥ ⌈1.5·y⌉, episodes ≥ ⌈0.5·y⌉, lot years ≥ 3, every pooled book ≥ ⌈0.4·y⌉ lots); and in the test window new funded lots ≥ ⌈1.5·yTest⌉ and new episodes ≥ ⌈0.5·yTest⌉
testRules.T7: capital efficiency: net per occupied $100k-year on the run to the test end ≥ $11000
testRules.ambiguous: passes T1–T7 but the pooled share is ≤ 0.93, at least one test set fails T2, or the centre DD is ≥ $33000
testRules.blockOnly: the test doors flag; they never re-rank, replace or re-select
testRules.nomination: F24 role holders with status pass (or ambiguous, labelled) in the sealed F24 order; the primary nominee is the top-ranked one; possibly none
testRules.outcome: qualified (≥ 1 nomination) | stable-but-weaker only (an F24 role holder passes T1, T2 and T2b but fails another T gate) | none
testRules.persistence: per fold: non-failed role holders ÷ role holders; non-failed shortlist members ÷ shortlist members (qualified and not, separately); descriptive
testRules.insufficient: a fold with no role holder, or whose role holders took fewer than 3 new funded test-window lots in total, is "insufficient evidence"
